actions.instruction: Inspect the proposal with its exact bound validator; preserve the assessment.
Review the assessment and identify missing consumers and migration obligations.

claim_ceiling: Static procedure coherence only. Instructions and gate conditions are text; no execution or successful outcome is inferred.

gates.condition: The validator accepts exact bindings and supplied regression expectations.
Each unresolved obligation has a named owner and continuation route.

inputs.description: Exact schema change record and its bound inputs.

outputs.description: Review findings and unresolved consumer obligations.

purpose: Turn a proposed schema change into reviewable evidence and unresolved obligations.
recomposition_rule: Version the Method and review affected gates whenever fixed fields change. Retain earlier evidence and open residue.

residue_rule.instruction: Record failure, affected inputs and missing evidence; stop before claiming completion.

reuse.specialization_rule: Bind an exact Method version to the chosen scope in a separate Method Binding; preserve open residue.

validation_rule.completion_condition: Both checks have evidence of success and remaining obligations are recorded; completion does not authorize adoption.
